name: singlet_harmonization_gene_identifier_mapping
title: Gene identifier and symbol mapping
description: Maps each feature name of a count matrix to one current gene in a pinned HGNC and Ensembl release, writing a stable Ensembl gene ID, the approved symbol and an explicit status (unique, renamed, ambiguous, unmapped). Collapses duplicate or versioned features with a logged conservation check. Use it before matching gene names to external resources. Do not use it to take an alias or first hit silently, or to map orthologs across species.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

species.description: Organism whose release tables are used. Only human is implemented in this version.

release_pin.description: Reference release as HGNC snapshot date plus Ensembl release, for example hgnc-<date>+ensembl-<release>. Required; no default.

feature_key.description: Column holding the input names: the feature index, or the var column gene_id or gene_name.

method.description: release_table resolves names against the pinned tables and is the default; name_suffix_only only makes display names unique.

layer.description: Count layer collapsed when duplicate_policy merges features; not read otherwise.

device.description: Only cpu is implemented; lookups are hash operations and gain nothing from CUDA.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing members.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

strip_version.description: Remove Ensembl version suffixes before lookup; the version is kept in var/ensembl_version.

alias_policy.description: all also resolves alias symbols; alias-only matches get status renamed and a log row, never unique.

ambiguity_policy.description: report keeps ambiguous features with candidates; drop removes and logs them; pick_first takes the first candidate and logs it.

unmapped_policy.description: keep_and_flag keeps unmapped features; drop_and_log removes them with a log row. Silent drops are not allowed.

duplicate_policy.description: sum for integer counts; mean for normalised or log values; keep_first; suffix_id keeps rows labelled name_ID.

join.description: Delimiter placed before the counter when a duplicated display name is made unique.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Counts per mapping status, resolution rate, collapsed and dropped features, conservation error.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
